ψαλλω.def: probably strengthened from ψάω (to rub or touch the surface; compare ψώχω (G5597)); to twitch or twang, i.e. to play on a stringed instrument (celebrate the divine worship with music and accompanying odes). KJV: make melody, sing (psalms).

ψαλμοσ.def: from ψάλλω (G5567); a set piece of music, i.e. a sacred ode (accompanied with the voice, harp or other instrument; a "psalm"); collectively, the book of the Psalms. KJV: psalm.

ψευδαδελφοσ.def: from ψευδής (G5571) and ἀδελφός (G80); a spurious brother, i.e. pretended associate. KJV: false brethren.

ψευδαποστολοσ.def: from ψευδής (G5571) and ἀπόστολος (G652); a spurious apostle, i.e. pretended pracher. KJV: false teacher.

ψευδησ.def: from ψεύδομαι (G5574); untrue, i.e. erroneous, deceitful, wicked. KJV: false, liar.

ψευδοδιδασκαλοσ.def: from ψευδής (G5571) and διδάσκαλος (G1320); a spurious teacher, i.e. propagator of erroneous Christian doctrine. KJV: false teacher.

ψευδολογοσ.def: from ψευδής (G5571) and λέγω (G3004); mendacious, i.e. promulgating erroneous Christian doctrine. KJV: speaking lies.

ψευδομαι.def: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to utter an untruth or attempt to deceive by falsehood. KJV: falsely, lie.

ψευδομαρτυρ.def: from ψευδής (G5571) and a kindred form of μάρτυς (G3144); a spurious witness, i.e. bearer of untrue testimony. KJV: false witness.

ψευδομαρτυρεω.def: from ψευδομάρτυρ (G5575); to be an untrue testifier, i.e. offer falsehood in evidence. KJV: be a false witness.

ψευδομαρτυρια.def: from ψευδομάρτυρ (G5575); untrue testimony. KJV: false witness.

ψευδοπροφητησ.def: from ψευδής (G5571) and προφήτης (G4396); a spurious prophet, i.e. pretended foreteller or religious impostor. KJV: false prophet.

ψευδοσ.def: from ψεύδομαι (G5574); a falsehood. KJV: lie, lying.

ψευδοχριστοσ.def: from ψευδής (G5571) and Χριστός (G5547); a spurious Messiah. KJV: false Christ.

ψευδωνυμοσ.def: from ψευδής (G5571) and ὄνομα (G3686); untruly named. KJV: falsely so called.

ψευσμα.def: from ψεύδομαι (G5574); a fabrication, i.e. falsehood. KJV: lie.

ψευστησ.def: from ψεύδομαι (G5574); a falsifier. KJV: liar.

ψηλαφαω.def: from the base of ψάλλω (G5567) (compare ψῆφος (G5586)); to manipulate, i.e. verify by contact; figuratively, to search for. KJV: feel after, handle, touch.

ψηφιζω.def: from ψῆφος (G5586); to use pebbles in enumeration, i.e. (generally) to compute. KJV: count.

ψηφοσ.def: from the same as ψηλαφάω (G5584); a pebble (as worn smooth by handling), i.e. (by implication, of use as a counter or ballot) a verdict (of acquittal) or ticket (of admission); a vote. KJV: stone, voice.

ψιθυρισμοσ.def: from a derivative of ψίθος (a whisper; by implication, a slander; probably akin to ψεύδομαι (G5574)); whispering, i.e. secret detraction. KJV: whispering.

ψιθυριστησ.def: from the same as ψιθυρισμός (G5587); a secret calumniator. KJV: whisperer.

ψιχιον.def: diminutive from a derivative of the base of ψάλλω (G5567) (meaning a crumb); a little bit or morsel. KJV: crumb.

ψυχη.def: from ψύχω (G5594); breath, i.e. (by implication) spirit, abstractly or concretely (the animal sentient principle only; thus distinguished on the one hand from πνεῦμα (G4151), which is the rational and immortal soul; and on the other from ζωή (G2222), which is mere vitality, even of plants: these terms thus exactly correspond respectively to the Hebrew H5315, H7307 and H2416). KJV: heart (+ -ily), life, mind, soul, + us, + you.

ψυχικοσ.def: from ψυχή (G5590); sensitive, i.e. animate (in distinction on the one hand from πνευματικός (G4152), which is the higher or renovated nature; and on the other from φυσικός (G5446), which is the lower or bestial nature). KJV: natural, sensual.

ψυχροσ.def: from ψύχος (G5592); chilly (literally or figuratively). KJV: cold.

ψυχω.def: a primary verb; to breathe (voluntarily but gently, thus differing on the one hand from πνέω (G4154), which denotes properly a forcible respiration; and on the other from the base of ἀήρ (G109), which refers properly to an inanimate breeze), i.e. (by implication, of reduction of temperature by evaporation) to chill (figuratively). KJV: wax cold.

ψωμιζω.def: from the base of ψωμίον (G5596); to supply with bits, i.e. (generally) to nourish. KJV: (bestow to) feed.

ψωμιον.def: diminutive from a derivative of the base of ψώχω (G5597); a crumb or morsel (as if rubbed off), i.e. a mouthful. KJV: sop.

ψωχω.def: prolongation from the same base as ψάλλω (G5567); to triturate, i.e. (by analogy) to rub out (kernels from husks with the fingers or hand). KJV: rub.
